## Safety check

- [ ] Changes to heat rules (risk levels, breaks, acclimatization, check-ins) cite their source in the code and in `docs/heat-science.md`.
- [ ] New user-facing text is wrapped for translation and has a Spanish translation (`make messages`).
- [ ] Text messages stay short and plain.

## Testing

- [ ] `make lint` and `make test` pass.
- [ ] Screenshots attached for UI changes (phone width first).

## Changelog

- [ ] Added an entry under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
